objective: Make user-owned compute connection simple for normal users by adding provider-aware OAuth/guided connection flows without changing ComputeRouter, worker, CAS, or F07 authority.

rulesConsidered: Provider authentication is separate from provider execution authority.
Raw provider secrets remain server-side and never enter journals, telemetry, MCP payloads, or F06 worker authority.
Provider completion is not physical artifact truth.
CAS owns immutable artifact identity and F07 remains the independent physical truth boundary.
No self-hosted PandaStack connection is introduced.

notes: Kaggle OAuth state is signed and bound to the authenticated user plus a short-lived HttpOnly cookie.
Kaggle refresh/access tokens are stored through the existing encrypted connection store.
Kaggle organization OAuth credentials are deployment secrets and are never returned to users.
No raw credential value is exposed in the public connection record.

changes: Added provider connection experience metadata and friendly credential input definitions.
Added Kaggle OAuth authorization, callback, token exchange, token introspection, and server-side refresh support.
Added modern Kaggle API-token fallback while retaining legacy username/key compatibility.
Added Lightning guided programmatic connection UX with User ID, API key, and Teamspace; explicitly no invented OAuth.
Added user-safe connected provider cards and removed environment-variable names from the normal UI.
Added OAuth connection upsert and encrypted secret rotation support.
verificationPlan: Pass Compute Connection Hub contract tests and FactoryOS typecheck.
Pass repository CI and Team Change Gate.
Configure a registered Kaggle OAuth client in the deployment and exercise the real hosted callback before calling one-click Kaggle LIVE.
Keep Lightning on guided programmatic auth until an official third-party authorization surface exists.
